quality.review_scope: Derived from the hash-bound inherited full main+SI extraction and current owner source notes. The current canonical projection and asset/Reader mapping are pending independent current-field audit; condition/sample joins remain limited to explicit source statements. Main PDF p. 2 (printed p. 2892), Materials paragraph states all chemicals were used as received; the same paragraph separately specifies molecular-sieve drying and high-purity Ar purging of solvents for 30 min before use. Elemental sulfur has no separately reported purity.
missing_fields: phase identity/fraction at each time point
Molecular-sieve specification and amount are not reported.
Elemental sulfur purity is not separately reported; the main p. 2 Materials paragraph states chemicals were used as received and separately specifies solvent pretreatment.
conflicts: Main text describes Cu3SbS4-to-Cu12Sb4S13 evolution but does not assign exact conversion time to each trace.

Methods text literally states a 1:3 Cu(acac)2:SbCl3·6H2O ratio for the tetrahedrite/skinnerite routes, while Scheme 1, Figure 1 and Results depict Cu:Sb = 3:1. This record encodes only the Figure 1/Scheme 1 condition-map ratio; absolute feed quantities remain unreported except where separately stated.
